title: Enhanced Combat Page View
description: Port of Cyaminthe's Enhanced Combat Page View (Workshop 2802216129) as a host callback on an observation gate: the combat pages in the hand are zoomed (x1.25, 25% bigger, by default), and in Touchscreen Mode a tap on another page swaps the selected page. For Library of Ruina 1.0.3.

launcher.label: Enhanced Combat Page View
launcher.note: Gives you the ability to Zoom-in combat pages on your hand, along with other fixes. Original mod by [Cyaminthe’s Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2802216129)

settings.label: Page zoom
settings.note: How much bigger the combat pages in your hand are. x1.25 is 25% bigger.

settings.label: Page Swapping
settings.note: Swap selected pages without having to unselect your current page (only available in touchscreen mode)

obs._comment: main build ID -> rows {gate, offset, word, reason}; offsets are RVAs of dump.cs (main = RVA + 0x234000 in the DmIOS file).

aeea627ddbd1214764dfef5f965e94a2.reason: BattleUnitCardsInHandUI.Update entry (once a frame): x0 = the hand; _cardList at 0x18

BattleDiceCardUI.OnPdSubmit entry + 4 (after touch-ui's hover gate at +0): x0 = the pressed combat page, x1 = the event data; GetClickableState refuses a page while the hand holds a selected one, because ShowDetail leaves _bEntered clear
